snippet.title: Hybrid 64 v3.0 Trailer
snippet.description:
Hybrid 64's next patch is finally revealed! Characters get a retro makeover for 3.0, and new mechanics change up gameplay! Discover new combos with Smash 64's mechanics without leaving your Melee techskill behind!

Links:
• GameBanana: https://gamebanana.com/gamefiles/9312
• Modulous: https://modulous.net/mod/1788/Hybrid%2064
• Smashboards Thread: https://smashboards.com/threads/hybrid-64-current-version-3-0.484819/
• Patch Notes (vMelee NTSC 1.02 - Hybrid 64 v3.0): https://pastebin.com/wGVdtp9G
• Patch Notes (Hybrid 64 v2.21 - Hybrid 64 v3.0): https://pastebin.com/DcNTiQjN

Join the Hybrid 64 Official Discord!
https://discord.gg/HXpgzYW

Special Thanks:
• UnclePunch: Created codes to enhance this mod's overall experience.
• DRGN: Melee Code Manager and DAT Texture Wizard tools.
• Ampers: Created the Crazy Hand tool to allow character edits.
• Taukhan: Added Yoshi Shield Stun and allowed for UCF implementation.
• Ploaj: Developed HSDraw, making all the aesthetics possible!
• Connor Rentz: Creator of the Melee64 Texture Pack!
• Lux!, Stormghetti: Playtesting and balancing.
• Charmy/Lofi: Support, New Logo, and additional texturing help.

Music Used: Harmony of Heroes - Target Blitz
Artist(s): Buoy
Source track: Targets! (Melee)
Original composer: Hirokazu Ando, Tadashi Ikegami, Shogo Sakai & Takuto Kitsuta
